result.definition: Participants in this cluster reported keeping most posts and opposing removal except when there was clear, concrete misbehavior such as name-calling or excessive harsh language, often justified by a general freedom-of-speech stance.
result.salience_notes: The sampled features cohere around reluctance to remove due to free-speech values, with removal framed as only necessary under specific linguistic transgressions (e.g., cursing/hyperbole/name calling).
